# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are developed against the latest code on `main`. Once versioned
releases are published, update this table to list the release branches that are
still receiving security fixes.

| Version | Supported |
|---|---|
| `main` | Yes |
| Older releases | No, unless explicitly listed here |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Do not report security vulnerabilities in public issues or pull requests.**

Use the repository's **Security** tab and select **Advisories → Report a
vulnerability** to send a private report to the maintainers. Include the
affected version/commit, impact, reproduction steps, and any suggested
mitigation. Do not include live credentials, private keys, or customer data.
